title: Governance register row
description: Governance of one managed hierarchy entry: owners, review cadence, triggers and freshness rule. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: journey_id (identity), owner (an unowned journey is not governed), review_interval_days, last_reviewed_at and next_review_due (the cadence is the point of the record; next_review_due is on or after last_reviewed_at). evidence_steward, metric_owners (roles, ';'-separated), review_triggers (';'-separated values of the review_trigger enumeration) and freshness_rule may be pending.

metric_owners.description: Roles that own the journey's metrics, ';'-separated; the per-metric owner stays in the metric register.

next_review_due.description: ISO 8601 date, on or after last_reviewed_at.
